text.p: Italian futures and cash bonds were slightly firmer in early trade reflecting the higher trend to the lira and German bunds, but trading was set to be quiet with London's LIFFE market closed for a public holiday, dealers said.
"With no LIFFE market today, BTPs are set to drift and watch trends in other markets," said one dealer.
Some look ahead and see a possible cut in Italy's 6.75 percent discount rate on Tuesday when the final CPI data for April are released, but other dealers see a cut coming at the end of this month.
